note: Authored Q&A over a public-domain USGS fact sheet (Timan-Pechora Basin assessment, 2018). References are hand-written; knownFacts are short strings a faithful extraction should surface. No gold accuracy is claimed — F1 is against these references, KnownFactCoverage is a reference-free structural check.

questions.question: What is the mean estimate of undiscovered technically recoverable oil in the province?
questions.reference: The mean undiscovered technically recoverable oil is about 1.4 billion barrels.

questions.question: What is the mean estimate of undiscovered gas in the province?
questions.reference: The mean undiscovered gas is about 46 trillion cubic feet.

questions.question: How many continuous assessment units were assessed?
questions.reference: Four continuous assessment units were assessed.

questions.question: Where is most of the assessed gas located?
questions.reference: Most of the gas, about 78 percent, is in the Ural Foredeep Continuous Gas assessment unit.

questions.question: What is the total organic carbon content of the source rocks?
questions.reference: The source rocks have high total organic carbon, up to about 20 weight percent.

questions.question: Who conducted the assessment and in what year?
questions.reference: The U.S. Geological Survey conducted the assessment in 2018.
